name: Dirt Street
desc1: Until recently, this was an undeveloped field, intended for use by
desc2: the guild.  However, necessity and the larege influx of permanent
desc3: residents have created a sort of housing development made up of tents
desc4: and shacks and other thrown together protection from the snow.  There
desc5: are campfires burning openly on the ground and people gathered around
desc6: doling out food.  Children run about, oblivious to the dark times.
